youtube.title: Night Prayer Before Sleep | Psalm 121:8 KJV
youtube.text:
End the day with this promise.

"The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore." Psalm 121:8 (KJV)

Fall asleep to the Word: Psalms 105–124, KJV, read slowly: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JJQjAr3xG0g

Type amen, and send this to someone who can't sleep.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#NightPrayer #BibleVersesForSleep #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
